threshold_provenance.ALPHA: two-sided significance level 0.05, the conventional statistical standard used for every hypothesis test in this module
threshold_provenance.STRONG_ALPHA: 0.01, used only to separate a High from a Medium confidence label once a p-value already exists
threshold_provenance.WILSON_Z_95: normal quantile for a two-sided 95% interval, imported from pipeline/calibration_common.py
threshold_provenance.MIN_SEGMENT_N: minimum rows before a segment estimate is reported at all; significance itself is decided by the Wilson interval, not by this floor
threshold_provenance.MIN_CLV_N: minimum graded picks before a CLV proportion test is attempted; significance itself is decided by the Wilson interval
threshold_provenance.REDUNDANCY_THRESHOLD: inherited from pipeline/train_common.feature_redundancy_report; a pair is only reported when the Fisher-z 95% interval for |r| also excludes this value
threshold_provenance.MIN_ROWS_FOR_VERDICT: evidence floor for per-feature verdicts; below it every feature resolves to NOT ENOUGH DATA rather than a guess
threshold_provenance.MIN_FOLDS_FOR_STABILITY: minimum walk-forward folds before a rank-stability statistic is defined
